evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: diagonal band field at one fixed angle, blue and olive stripes separated by cream gaps, dense in the upper-right and sparse at the left; by shot-20s the bands pair into two mirrored rectangles.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one flat fill layer with domain-warped band edges and two band pitches; by shot-20s a mirror copy across the centre line adds a second rectangle, so about two layers with no lighting or material.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: palette of indigo, olive, slate blue and cream is cohesive, but band edges stair-step visibly at full size; shot-20s shows a messy notch where the two mirrored halves overlap at top and bottom centre.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: olive, slate and cream bands on a diagonal grid share no palette or idea with the apricot sand grid or the coral branching of the last nights; the pole-wrap band rule is specific to this piece.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: a detached sliver beside a bare indigo rectangle, not yet composed; by shot-20s the piece resolves into a centred mirror composition that clearly ends differently from its start.

pairwise_justification: Tonight's shot-08s has a striped indigo, olive and cream diagonal field with clear rhythm; the median's shot-08s is a single orange diamond blob on a speckled tan square with little structure. Tonight wins.

critique.change: Shade the gathered edge of each band with a darker warp gradient so the pleat compression reads as cloth being scrunched, not flat stripes, visible from shot-08s onward.
Anti-alias the band edges in the shader (smoothstep over about one pixel) so the olive and blue boundaries at shot-08s stop stair-stepping at full size.
Clean the notch where the two mirrored halves overlap at top and bottom centre in shot-20s, so the end state reads as one deliberate composition rather than two pasted rectangles.
